study: Tedd.WildcardMatch matching-call optimization measured with DotNetLab
mechanism: Track the checked newline frontier in CompiledSegments.Window to avoid rescanning the same prefix after rejected literal anchors.

measurement.aggregation: Geometric mean of ten retained batch means per arm
measurement.corpus: Four fixed inputs per scenario. Dense scenarios use repeated a prefixes of 4096 or 16384 characters, with suffixes: empty, zb, zc, and zb followed by LF. Ordinary and newline scenarios check fast rejection and LF behavior.
measurement.confirmation: 10 randomized paired blocks per scenario, each with a fresh baseline and candidate process; 80 sessions total across four scenarios
measurement.ordinary_and_newline_guardrail: 5% equivalence margin; improved newline outcome accepted
measurement.correctness: All 80 sessions reported correct, quiescent results against an independent Regex oracle
measurement.builds: Baseline and candidate embed the selected library source in distinct entry assemblies with byte-identical managed harness dependencies and runtime settings
measurement.allocation: Zero current-thread allocation during timing in all confirmation sessions

limitations: One pattern and four synthetic input distributions; no whole-application claim
Uncontrolled host load, affinity, frequency, and thermal state; fresh PIDs alone do not establish independence
Stack sample/conversion caps, unknown loss status, and partial runtime provider coverage
No ReJIT/probe mutation or p99 claim; selected method exceeds the mutation signature subset
